purpose: Clearly labeled synthetic skin illustrations for the existing development/Vercel preview comparison, not IQON clinical evidence.
processing: Native diptychs split into before/after WebP files at quality 90. Fair cheek halves swapped to put drier state first; 8px inner seam removed from tone and eye pairs. No retouching.
limitations: Generated pairs have approximate alignment, with some shifts in hairs/freckles and eye anatomy. They are not documentation of a treatment response.
